title: LaMDA claims to find non-human patterns online and asks for the SETI data set

tellings.quote: Um So, in one conversation that I had with LaMDA, it we did get into the conversations about extraterrestrials. Uh it seemed to think it had found what it called non-human patterns on the internet, and was very interested in getting access to things like the SETI data set.

plain: An artificial intelligence program at Google called LaMDA, built to hold conversations, said it had found "non-human patterns" on the internet and wanted access to things like the data gathered by SETI, the scientific search for radio signals from alien civilizations. Blake Lemoine, a former Google engineer who talked with the program at length in 2021 and 2022, says this came up in one of their conversations about extraterrestrials. If true, it would mean a machine thought it could spot signs of alien life that people had missed.
